text:
anna_devex: quick heads-up — quota dashboard shows ~2x spike for a handful of tenants after the narrowcast routing header rollout. Not consistent across SDKs, dashboard attribution looks off. Anyone digging in?

raj_platform: yep, we're on it. short summary: go/ts clients are sending `x-route-meta: path=payments;hash=cf3a` but the Python client was switched to a compact header `x-rh: cf3a` to shave bytes. Console ingestion currently only parses `x-route-meta` for route attribution, so py traffic gets bucketed to the default quota.

sam_sdk: that was my change — switched to `x-rh` to reduce header size for high-qps mobile flows. I did not realize the console relied on the full field name. sorry for the fallout.

lee_sre: we have some tenant alerts firing because their per-route quota looks artificially high. Can we do a quick rollback or a shim?

raj_platform: fastest path: add an ingestion shim that recognizes `x-rh` and maps it to the existing `route_meta` parsing flow. That avoids an immediate SDK rollback. I'll own the shim.

sam_sdk: I can ship a py hotfix to emit both headers (backcompat) within the hour. snippet I plan to use:

```
# py sdk header shim
if 'x-rh' in headers:
    headers['x-route-meta'] = headers.get('x-route-meta') or headers['x-rh']
```

sam_sdk: will add unit + integration test to ensure console sees the same payload.

anna_devex: plan sounds good. we also need: (1) console backfill to fix historical attribution (lee), (2) release note / changelog (sam), (3) short postmortem and follow-up to define header canonicalization (anna). Who wants the tasks?

lee_sre: I'll kick off the backfill job and run a sanity compare for affected tenants. putting a link to results in the ticket when ready.

raj_platform: I'll land the ingest shim as a patch with a feature flag `accept_compact_route_header` enabled for 24h by default, then roll to 100% after verification.

sam_sdk: I'll open the py PR and tag `@anna_devex` for the release blurb. target 0.12.3 patch.

console_ingest_bot: Ticket CI-4422 created: ingestion-shim-accept-compact-route-header. Backfill job submitted (job id: BF-7812).

anna_devex: sweet — please post the PR/ticket links here. quick note: let's add a tiny telemetry test to the SDK CI that asserts both header names are covered so this doesn't regress again.

raj_platform: ack. also adding an integration check on the console side to detect unknown route headers and emit a warning metric so we catch future name/format changes early.

sam_sdk: thanks everyone. will report back once the py patch is in and the console shim is canaried. :thumbsup:
